blueprint_sources: Bay Area infill townhome type — 3-story wood frame on concrete podium, attached 2-car garage at grade
KB Home/Shea Homes Bay Area townhome product — 2BR/2.5BA 1,400 sqft over garage
Oakland Measure C RHNA infill — 4-story attached townhome with shared party walls and individual utility metering

petronus_classification.note: Attached infill townhome on concrete podium. Party walls on 1-2 sides create fire and acoustic constraints. Energy code (Title 24 2022) requires ERV/HRV for mechanical ventilation. Individual metering and EV charging per unit are mandated. Roof equipment coordination with solar is critical.

lot.note: Infill lot. High lot coverage typical. Narrow width with party walls on sides. Front elevation faces street; rear may face alley or shared courtyard.

structure.podium_note: Concrete podium at garage level (P1) with wood frame above. Podium provides fire separation between garage and residential above.
structure.party_wall_note: Party walls (demising walls) are 2-hour fire-rated double-stud construction. No penetrations allowed for MEP — not even conduit sleeves.
structure.soft_story_note: Open podium garage at grade creates soft-story condition. Concrete shear walls in podium required. Wood shear walls at upper floors.

floor_program.note: Program stacked over attached garage. Garage at grade (P1), living/kitchen on L1, bedrooms on L2 and L3.

ground_level_garage.mep_note: Main panel, EV charging circuits (240V/50A per unit), sub-panel to upper floors, mechanical room if applicable. Sprinkler riser and main. Fire separation from residential above via concrete podium.

floor_1.mep_note: Kitchen wet wall central or rear. Half bath must stack below L2 bath. ERV/HRV unit located here or in utility closet — must have intake and exhaust penetrations to exterior (NOT through party walls).

floor_2.mep_note: Wet walls must stack above L1 kitchen/half bath. Laundry closet stacks above L1 utility. No wet fixtures within 24in of party wall — maintain fire integrity.

floor_3_optional.mep_note: If bath present, continue DWV stack from L2 directly upward. ERV/HRV ductwork terminates at exterior wall penetrations here or on roof. Mechanical closet serves mini-split or air handler for top floor.

wet_wall.party_wall_plumbing_prohibition: CRITICAL: Under NO circumstances route any plumbing — supply, DWV, or refrigerant — through a party wall. Penetrations break the 2-hour fire rating and destroy acoustic separation. All wet walls must run parallel to but at least 12in away from party walls.
wet_wall.note: Stack runs vertically through center of unit. Kitchen on L1, laundry and baths on L2/L3 all connect to this central stack. Stack is interior and fully contained within unit boundaries.

staircase.mep_note: Stair occupies center spine. MEP vertical chases on opposite side from stair. Party walls cannot be used for chase routing — use interior partition walls parallel to unit long axis.

mep_chase.note: All vertical MEP chases must be entirely within the unit footprint. Route toward front or rear exterior walls for ERV/HRV terminations. Condenser and solar coordination required on roof — map roof real estate before finalizing MEP routing.

hvac.erv_hrv_note: Title 24 2022 requires whole-building mechanical ventilation in new airtight construction. ERV (Energy Recovery Ventilator) or HRV (Heat Recovery Ventilator) is mandatory. Unit must have dedicated intake and exhaust penetrations to exterior — not through party walls.
hvac.roof_coordination_note: Roof real estate must be divided between: solar PV panels (Title 24 required), HVAC condensers (one per unit or shared), and ERV/HRV exhaust/intake terminations. Generate roof plan before finalizing any rooftop equipment.

water_heater.note: Each unit gets its own HPWH. Route intake and exhaust air from utility closet via louvered door and transfer grille — NOT through party walls.

sprinklers.coordination_note: Sprinkler main feeds through podium slab. Branch lines serve each floor. Coordinate with HVAC ductwork to avoid sprinkler head blockage.

panel.individual_metering_note: Each unit must have a dedicated utility meter. Sub-panel per floor fed from main panel at garage level. Load calculations must include EV charger, HPWH, and HVAC simultaneously.

ev_charging.note: California ZEV mandate + local ordinances require EV-ready circuit per unit at minimum. Size for Level 2 EVSE (240V/50A).

solar.note: Multiple units sharing a roof — coordinate solar inverter placement with HVAC condensers and ERV terminations before finalizing roof layout.

massing_hints.note: Narrow attached unit. Facade is front-only expression (sides are party walls). Flat roof used as outdoor deck when local code allows. Contemporary materials — fiber cement, stucco, large windows.

known_constraints_summary: NO plumbing through party walls — EVER. Penetrations break 2-hour fire rating and acoustic separation. Route all wet walls parallel to and at least 12in from party walls.
ERV/HRV mandatory — Title 24 2022 requires whole-building mechanical ventilation in new airtight construction. Duct intake and exhaust to exterior through non-party walls only.
Roof real estate is shared between solar PV (required), HVAC condensers (per unit), and ERV/HRV terminations — generate roof plan before finalizing MEP routing.
Individual utility metering required per unit — coordinate with utility for separate meter sockets.
EV charging circuit (240V/50A) required per unit in dedicated garage circuit.
NFPA 13 sprinkler system throughout including garage — coordinate sprinkler heads with HVAC ductwork.
Concrete podium at garage creates soft-story condition — concrete shear walls in podium mandatory.
Seismic design category D — wood shear walls at all upper floors, concrete shear walls at podium level.
Load calculations must account for simultaneous operation of EV charger + HPWH + HVAC — do not undersize service.
DWV stack must be interior to unit — stack cannot share wall cavity with party wall on either side.
